title: Leica SL2 Full-Frame Mirrorless (50mm Summilux f/2.8)
purpose: Cinematic slow-shutter motion-blur and editorial calm vs. chaos photography with Maestro III processing, tack-sharp subject plane, and restrained indie-cinema monochrome.

sensor_and_optics.camera_system: Leica SL2 Full-Frame Mirrorless (Maestro III Processor)
sensor_and_optics.lens: Leica Summilux-SL 50mm f/1.4 ASPH stopped down to f/2.8
sensor_and_optics.iso_base: ISO 50 base sensor sensitivity with 14-bit DNG uncompressed raw
sensor_and_optics.dynamic_range: 14 stops dynamic range with restrained German tonal curve and indie-cinema monochrome
sensor_and_optics.shutter: Focal-plane shutter with slow shutter motion-blur aesthetic (steady camera relative to subject)

lighting_and_exposure.primary_lighting: Flat overcast natural daylight acting as soft diffusion, low contrast, gentle highlight roll-off
lighting_and_exposure.light_transport: Even diffuse daylight, soft highlight transitions, clean midtones, zero harsh contrast, allowing long crowd motion blur trails without specular blowouts

surface_rendering: Authentic Leica Summilux optical acutance at f/2.8: tack-sharp near-eye pupil, iris detail, eyelashes, and resolved natural facial pores
Subject standing completely still, centered, with tack-sharp anatomical presence
Hundreds of commuters rushing past in all directions (left-to-right, right-to-left, toward/away from camera, diagonal crossings), stretched into smooth multi-directional motion-blur trails
Clean motion streak physics wrapping around the still subject without deforming subject anatomy
Fine, subtle, consistent organic film grain
depth_and_optics: Chest-level frontal angle with natural 50mm perspective
Tack-sharp subject facial plane contrasted against dynamic multi-vector crowd blur
Readable urban transit concourse background dominated by motion blur without collapsing into a uniform smear wall

execution_directive: Enforce Leica SL2 47.3MP full-frame documentary realism with 50mm Summilux at f/2.8. Maintain tack-sharp still subject with resolved pores and iris detail amidst multi-directional slow-shutter crowd motion blur trails in restrained indie-cinema monochrome.
